Use case: ui-mockup. Create realistic, production-quality UI designs with clear hierarchy, strong typography, intentional imagery, and purposeful spacing. Target dimensions 1440 wide by 1120 high, desktop website section design only, no browser chrome, no device mockup, no full app card. User: a video editor's Chinese portfolio for employers. Existing white and pale lavender website is reference image 1: use it only for colors, typography and generous whitespace; REPLACE its entire poster carousel with a new clickable transparent 3D jelly tag wall and selected-work recommendation. Reference image 2 is the actual existing 花舞瞬间 portfolio cover; reuse that artwork accurately in the selected-work preview, do not invent video screenshots.
Hard constraints: WHITE background, charcoal Chinese sans-serif typography, very pale lavender #e7def4 and muted purple #7458a3 accents with some ice blue and pale peach. A tasteful UI that can be implemented using Three.js WebGPU. Jelly labels have REAL visible 3D thickness, smooth pill silhouettes, rounded inflated soft-gel edges, clear light-transmitting colored material, soft refraction at the curved perimeter, glossy wide studio highlights and subtle contact shadows. They should look like squishable transparent gelatin, not opaque plastic and not flat CSS gradient chips. Chinese text on labels MUST remain crisp, dark, undistorted and readily readable. Restrained angles, labels do not overlap their text or hit areas. No extraneous decorative objects, no emoji, no techno HUD, no excessive rainbow. Show exactly 15 labels, each once, spelled correctly: 音乐节奏, 叙事剪辑, 画面编排, 字幕排版, 视觉包装, 真人口播, 保险科普, 艺术短片, 人物故事, 城市文旅, 广告视觉, AI 视觉, 拍摄与剪辑, 后期全流程, 模板制作.
Semantics: five ability labels lavender, seven content type labels icy blue, three employer interest labels pale peach. Selected label 音乐节奏 has slightly deeper lavender material and tiny checkmark. Description exact: 这支艺术短片适合先看音乐与画面节奏的配合。 Short role copy exact: 素材筛选 / 画面编排 / 音乐匹配. Primary button 播放作品, secondary text link 查看项目详情. One or two supporting text links for related works 神奇的蛋糕 and 梦幻绘画. Small bottom link 全部作品 20. Do not add ratings, statistics, progress bars, extra navigation or unsupported performance claims. Body 14-16 px minimum, labels 18-22px as appropriate, title around 42px, no clipped letters. Purposeful whitespace. Current date anchor 2026-10-14; no date needs to appear in this view. This is one independent concept per image; do not include concept names or option numbers.
Distinct concept: 果冻陈列墙. Centered heading top, large visually rich but orderly jelly-tag wall arranged over four relaxed staggered rows occupying upper half. The abilities 音乐节奏, 叙事剪辑, 视觉包装 are slightly larger. Wall around 340px tall with asymmetric pill widths and gentle angles within 5 degrees, generous gaps. Beneath a thin divider, editorial two-column selected-work recommendation: left a 440px wide accurate supplied flower cover, right selected focus and title, a few concise lines and actions. Supporting related works are minimal text links at bottom. Base page surface, not contained in card. The tag wall is the protagonist but cover and explanation remain clearly readable in lower half. Keep all elements within frame.

verification.content: 15 个标签与主体作品、时长和按钮均可见；正式文字以标签内容.json 为准。
limitations: 视觉稿 1 的拍摄与剪辑标签生成成蓝色；实现时应按内容配置使用淡桃色。
视觉稿 2 的两枚相关作品缩略图为图像生成构图，实施时必须替换为站内真实对应封面。
这三张是静态视觉稿；透明折射、形变、兼容性和性能尚未在 WebGPU 中验证。
